description: First year of secondary English (1ère année de l'enseignement secondaire, tronc commun): thirty-five lessons from Perform through English — meeting people and talking about yourself, narrating past events with the simple past and the present perfect, pronouns, the genitive, the passive, reported speech, past habits with used to, modals of obligation and advice, comparatives and superlatives, relative clauses and the first conditional, through reading, listening, speaking and writing
